message.reasoning_content:

So rule: when facts mention smuggling or illegal transport of goods, include smuggling charge. Also need to detect multiple crimes. So rule: If the factual description includes elements of smuggling (e.g., illegal import/export, transport of contraband, customs violation) in addition to theft, assign both smuggling and theft. Keywords: "走私", "普通货物", "物品", "海关", "非法运输", "走私普通货物". Also "盗窃" etc.
